info.description: Resources hub list: a single featured card, a swipeable row, or a filterable paged grid (All Articles, audience strips, eBooks, Podcasts). Fill in a hand-picked list or an audience to narrow it — leave both empty for the newest resources.

navItem.description: This section's entry in the page's on-page menu: the chip label + the anchor it scrolls to (which also becomes the section's DOM id). Leave empty to keep the section out of the menu.

layout.description: How the resources are presented. featured = one large card, featuredCarousel = one large card per slide, carousel = a swipeable row of cards, grid = a static grid, gridFiltered = grid with filters + paging.

audience.description: Show the newest resources for ONE primary audience (an audience strip). Leave empty for the newest of every audience.

insights.description: A hand-picked list, in your order. Takes precedence over the audience and the type.

resourceType.description: Show only one resource type (eBook, podcast…). Leave empty for every type. Ignored when a list is hand-picked.

itemsToShow.description: How many resources this section renders: slides when it is a carousel, cards otherwise (default 3). Ignored by the filterable grid, which pages from Strapi.
